paite: Pathian aw, na gouluah ding ah namte alut ua; na tempul siangthou ahihnin uhi; kisesa in Jerusalem akoih uhi.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Nam Hotkhiakna Dia Thumna

paite: Na sikhate luang tungleng vasate an ding in apia ua, na misiangthoute sa gamsate kiang ah apia ua.
Asisan uh Jerusalem kim ah tui bang in asungbua ua; amau vui ding lah kuamah a-om ngal kei uhi.
I kim ua mite gensiat in i na om ua, i kiangnai a mite muhsit leh nuihsan in i na omta uhi.
TOUPA aw, bang tan ahia na heh nilouh ding? Na mullitna mei bang in akuang ding ahia?
Nangmah thei lou namte tung a na hehna sungbua in, na min sam lou gam tung ah.
Jakobte ane khin ua; a-omna uh ahihgamta uhi.
Ka pipute uh thulimlouhnate ka lak uah theigige ke'n; na lainatna in hon don pah hen. Nakpitak a hihniam in ka omta ngal ua.
Hon hondampa Pathian aw, na min thupina ding in hon panpih inla; na min ziak in hon humbit in, ka khelhnate uh silsiang in.
Bang achia namte'n, a Pathian uh koi a omta ahia le, chi ding uh ahia? Na sikhate sisan pawt phulakna ka mitmuh un namte lak ah theih hi hen.
Henta thumna na ma ah tung hen; na thilhihtheihna thupidan bang zel in si ding a sehte humbit in.
TOUPA aw, nang ahon gensiatna uh, ka kiangnai uate tung ah aleh sagih in thuk in.
Huchi in kou na mite, na gantatna mun a belamte'n, tangtawn in kipahthu ka hon hilh ding uhi; suan tengteng tan in nangmah phatna ka theisak zel ding uhi.
